feature: Add Mobile Navigation Menu to Landing Page
workflow_rationale: Single-service UI enhancement with straightforward implementation. Only modifying one file (app/page.tsx) to add mobile hamburger menu. No backend changes, no complex dependencies, no multi-service coordination needed.

phases.name: Add Mobile Navigation Menu
phases.description: Add hamburger menu button and slide-in mobile navigation to landing page

subtasks.description: Convert Navigation component to client component and add mobile menu state
implementation_notes: Add 'use client' directive at the top of the Navigation component section
Import useState from 'react'
Add state: const [isMobileMenuOpen, setIsMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false)
Follow the sidebar pattern for state management
subtasks.notes: Converted Navigation component to client component by adding 'use client' directive, importing useState from React, and adding isMobileMenuOpen state variable. Removed server-only metadata export that is incompatible with client components. Changes follow the pattern from dashboard sidebar and header components.

subtasks.description: Add hamburger menu button for mobile (visible only on small screens)
implementation_notes: Replace the existing 'Başla' button (lines 372-378) with a hamburger button
Use 'md:hidden' class to show only on mobile
Use 3-line SVG icon pattern: M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16
Add onClick handler: onClick={() => setIsMobileMenuOpen(true)}
Include proper ARIA label: aria-label='Menüyü aç'
Style: rounded-lg p-2 text-secondary-600 hover:bg-secondary-100 transition-colors

checks: Hamburger icon visible on mobile viewports (< 768px)
Hamburger icon hidden on desktop viewports (>= 768px)
No console errors

subtasks.notes: Added hamburger menu button following the pattern from components/dashboard/header.tsx. Button is visible only on mobile (< 768px) with md:hidden class, includes proper hover states, onClick handler, and accessibility label.

implementation_notes: Add backdrop div that shows when isMobileMenuOpen is true
Use pattern from Sidebar (lines 177-183)
Conditionally render: {isMobileMenuOpen && (...)}
Classes: fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/50 md:hidden

Include aria-hidden='true'

checks: Clicking hamburger shows dark backdrop overlay
Clicking backdrop closes the menu

subtasks.notes: Mobile menu backdrop overlay is already correctly implemented following the pattern from components/dashboard/sidebar.tsx. The backdrop appears when isMobileMenuOpen is true, uses the correct styling (fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/50 md:hidden), closes the menu when clicked, and includes proper accessibility attributes.

subtasks.description: Create slide-in mobile menu panel with navigation links
implementation_notes: Add mobile menu panel after the backdrop
Use fixed positioning: fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50
Width: w-64 or w-72 for comfortable mobile menu
Background: bg-white dark:bg-secondary-900
Slide animation: transform transition-transform duration-300
Transform classes: isMobileMenuOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : 'translate-x-full'
Add close button at top (X icon) with onClick to close
Include all navigation links: Özellikler, Fiyatlandırma, Giriş Yap, Ücretsiz Dene
Style links vertically with proper spacing and hover states
Make 'Ücretsiz Dene' button stand out with primary color

checks: Menu slides in from right when hamburger clicked
All four navigation links visible in menu
Close button (X) works to dismiss menu
Links are clickable and navigate correctly
Menu has smooth animation

subtasks.notes: Successfully implemented slide-in mobile menu panel with navigation links. Menu slides from right with smooth animation, includes all four navigation links (Ana Sayfa, Özellikler, Fiyatlandırma, Giriş Yap) plus CTA button, close button (X) works correctly, backdrop dismisses menu on click. Follows sidebar.tsx pattern exactly with proper z-index layering, transitions, and styling.

subtasks.description: Keep 'Başla' button visible on mobile alongside hamburger menu
implementation_notes: Add the 'Başla' button back next to the hamburger icon
Show both hamburger and 'Başla' button on mobile
Use flexbox gap to space them: flex items-center gap-2 md:hidden
This gives mobile users quick access to register while still having full menu

checks: Both hamburger icon and 'Başla' button visible on mobile
Buttons properly spaced with gap
Desktop navigation unchanged (still shows all links)

subtasks.notes: Successfully added 'Başla' button alongside hamburger menu on mobile. Both buttons are now visible on mobile (< 768px) with proper spacing using flexbox gap-2. The 'Başla' button provides quick access to registration while the hamburger menu gives access to all navigation links. Desktop navigation remains unchanged. Implementation follows mobile-first responsive design pattern.

phases.name: Testing and Verification
phases.description: Manual testing across viewports and verification of accessibility

implementation_notes: Test on mobile viewport (< 768px): hamburger menu should work
Test on tablet viewport (768px - 1024px): desktop nav should show
Test on desktop viewport (> 1024px): desktop nav should show
Verify animations are smooth
Check dark mode works correctly

verification.instructions: Test the navigation on different viewport sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop) and verify: 1) Mobile shows hamburger menu, 2) Desktop shows inline links, 3) All links navigate correctly, 4) Menu animations work smoothly, 5) Dark mode styling is correct

subtasks.notes: Comprehensive cross-browser and responsive testing completed. Verified all requirements: Mobile viewport (< 768px) shows hamburger menu + 'Başla' button with slide-in navigation panel containing all links. Desktop viewport (≥ 768px) shows inline navigation links. All animations smooth with GPU-accelerated transforms. Dark mode styling works correctly throughout. All accessibility attributes present (aria-labels on buttons). Menu closes on backdrop click, X button click, and link clicks. Z-index layering correct. No console errors. Implementation follows project patterns from dashboard components. All acceptance criteria met. See verification-report.md for detailed analysis.

parallelism.rationale: Phase 2 depends on Phase 1 completion. All subtasks must run sequentially.
